sections.title: Overview
sections.text: Orbitra Inference Platform serves large language models and vision models behind an OpenAI-compatible API. It runs on-premises, in a private cloud or as a managed service.

sections.title: Performance and scaling
sections.text: The platform autoscales model replicas on request queue depth and supports batching. Typical latency targets are under 300 milliseconds to first token for 8B parameter models.

sections.title: Security
sections.text: Deployments can run fully inside a customer network with no data leaving the environment. Supports single sign-on, role-based access control and audit logging.

sections.title: Overview
sections.text: Orbitra Vector DB stores embeddings for retrieval augmented generation and semantic search. It combines vector similarity with keyword (BM25) search in one hybrid query.

sections.title: Access control
sections.text: Metadata filters such as territory, document owner and classification are applied inside the similarity search, so users only retrieve documents they are allowed to see.

sections.title: Freshness
sections.text: Incremental upserts keep the index current; catalogue or document changes are searchable within about one minute.

sections.title: Overview
sections.text: Orbitra Guard adds input, output and retrieval guardrails to generative AI applications.

sections.title: Privacy
sections.text: Detects and redacts personal data such as emails, phone numbers and names before text is sent to a model, and restores it for authorised users.

sections.title: Prompt injection
sections.text: Scans retrieved documents and user input for prompt injection patterns and quarantines suspicious content. Every decision is written to an audit log.

sections.title: Overview
sections.text: Orbitra Edge Appliance is a ruggedised GPU server for computer vision and language inference at factories, plants and remote sites.

sections.title: Environment
sections.text: Rated for 0 to 50 degrees Celsius and dust-protected enclosures. Runs disconnected and syncs models when connectivity returns.

sections.title: Latency
sections.text: Vision models typically run under 30 milliseconds per frame on the appliance.

sections.title: Overview
sections.text: Orbitra Document AI extracts fields and tables from scanned forms, invoices, bills of lading and claim forms.

sections.title: Accuracy
sections.text: Field-level extraction accuracy is typically above 95 percent on printed forms; handwritten annotations are supported in preview with lower accuracy.

name: Competitive brief: Kordon Cloud, Brightlake AI and Pyxel Compute

sections.title: Kordon Cloud
sections.text: Kordon Cloud is a hosted-only offering. Position Orbitra on private deployment, data residency and predictable pricing.

sections.title: Brightlake AI
sections.text: Brightlake AI offers a strong hosted API but limited regional hosting. Position Orbitra on data residency and audit trails.

sections.title: Pyxel Compute
sections.text: Pyxel Compute competes on GPU price. Position Orbitra on total cost including software, guardrails and support.

sections.title: Discount authority
sections.text: Account executives may approve discounts up to 10 percent. Discounts from 10 to 20 percent need sales manager approval. Anything above 20 percent goes to the deal desk.
